method: One genuine live snapshot per 27 games: chronological middle retained live state. Compare exact deployed baseline and upgraded scan with isolated in-memory SQLite. Feed refresh/scan times are simulated for byte measurement only. No providers, AI, network, new production data, or production writes.
quantiles: Nearest-rank p95; upper middle median for even count. Bytes are UTF-8 JSON; no invoice or deployed latency claim.
cachedSummaryMethod: For each existing NHL cached summary, use the genuine last retained live game state and its existing providerPath; source acquisition is aligned to simulated scan time solely to measure bounded event storage. Cached final revisions are not represented as original live revisions. No event time is invented.

cachedSummaries.bounded48EventsMethod: Storage arithmetic only: 48 copies of the largest serialized real event record seen in the 11 cached summaries, plus JSON array commas/brackets. This is an observed-record-size envelope, not an observed 48-event game or a global maximum for all possible provider fields.

limitations: Ledger absent in retained snapshot; actual future exact canonical ledger rows can add bytes.
Retained final summaries permit a bounded event payload estimate, not an actual contemporary cache replay.
Finding evidence duplicates observation details when a finding is persisted; byte distributions include per-observation JSON, with bindBytes reporting all bound statements.
Peer SELECT count is unchanged, but upgraded query returns up to 100 full evidence rows per sport/bucket instead of the baseline two-field rows.
NHL, CFB, NCAAB and hidden Soccer only; no observed NFL/NBA/MLB/Tennis storage sample.
In-memory SQLite counts statements; Cloudflare billed rows, network transfer, CPU time and invoices are not inferred.
